nativeWindow.verifiedBy: Root agent using Cua to inspect the live headful Playwright window
states: The beginning: complete heading, statement and descriptive paragraph
Opened Z-fold: alternating hinges, normally oriented faces and matte texture

nativeWindow.scope: Historical native desktop rendering evidence for previous release; not rerun for the wider-paper revision.

protocolScreenshots.finding: The screenshot API paints hidden backfaces as mirrored content. Native-window rendering is correct. An independent two-face card reproduces the same capture defect without application CSS or GSAP.

warnings.detail: One WebKit warning per viewport reported that the preloaded font was not used within a few seconds. These were warnings, not browser errors.

relationshipToChromium: 35 supplementary reading positions at three sizes; separately from the29 current Chromium browser checks.

intersectionObserver.finding: Nested 3D IntersectionObserver reported 0.593 for a fully framed cover. Verified by matching Chromium/WebKit bounds and a native-window screenshot. This run uses full bounds and composed face normals; Chromium keeps IntersectionObserver assertions.
intersectionObserver.acceptance: Full transformed bounds, composed camera/panel normals, minimum rendered font size and independent native-window review; Chromium retains the 98% intersection assertion.

hitTesting.claim: Diagnostic only; no complete clickability or occlusion pass claimed
hitTesting.finding: Right-wing targets can return the transparent ARTICLE.proposal-sheet ancestor from elementFromPoint in both Chromium and WebKit. Grid counts are diagnostics, not an occlusion or clickability pass; native-window review is required for actual paint.

headfulViewportLimitation: Headful WebKit retained desktop layout despite a reported 390px configured viewport. Headless mobile geometry is covered separately; native mobile and physical iOS remain unverified.
notes: The reported physical iPhone crash requires actual-device retry.
Updated material/culling is checked through rendered Chromium captures and supplementary WebKit geometry. Previous native-window review remains historical.
